evidence_notes: A replication of the WSP protocol on Qwen3-ASR-0.6B with nine Claude Opus agent arms is the whole report (p.1-3). Agents derive analytic edits (rank-1 projections, head gains) from weight and activation statistics in code under a logged forward-pass budget (p.3), so code_or_tensor_tool and closed loop; the test set is single-use and harness-locked, but no preregistration is described (p.3). Sonnet subagents built the harness and statistics and drafted the report, and an Opus orchestrator reviewed it (AI assistance, p.11); restoring the missing encoder mask with no weight change matched the best edit (p.1, p.8); edits, controls and logs are on Hugging Face (p.11).
